Answer: A
Reason: The chest X-ray shows complete opacification (white-out) of the right hemithorax with a distinct shift of the trachea and mediastinum to the left (contralateral side). This contralateral shift indicates a space-occupying lesion pushing structures away, which is characteristic of a massive pleural effusion rather than volume loss causes like atelectasis (which would pull the mediastinum ipsilaterally) or pneumonia (which typically preserves volume).
